stem: Which evidence would BEST support the claim that the phenotypes of these populations of mice are a result of natural selection?

options.label: A
options.text: A mutation in the same gene led to the coastal populations having the same coat color.

options.label: B
options.text: An allele for light coat color is more common in the coastal populations than the inland population.

options.label: C
options.text: The genes that code for a light coat color have been lost from the inland population.

options.label: D
options.text: The coastal and inland populations all share the same alleles for coat color.

notes: Includes a data table and question with four answer choices labeled A-D.
